column4: Pixel-art texture in the style of 1990s Build-engine games (Duke Nukem 3D, Blood, Redneck Rampage): a digitized photograph crudely retouched by hand by a 1996 game artist, chunky pixels, a limited muddy palette, hard edges, no text, no logos, no border, no watermark. A small cabin window at night seen straight on from outside, flat orthographic front view filling the whole square edge to edge: warm orange lamplight glowing through a white lace net curtain hung behind the glass, the dark brown wooden window cross dividing it into four panes, the light brightest in the middle and dimmer at the corners, a little dirt and a cobweb on the glass, the folds of the curtain readable. No frame outside the panes, no wall, no people.

A night sky panorama texture for a 1990s Build-engine game skybox (Duke Nukem 3D, Blood), in the same palette and pixel size as the reference: a clear moonless autumn night, deep navy blue low down fading to almost black high up, hundreds of small sharp white and pale blue stars of different sizes scattered all over, a faint grainy milky way band crossing diagonally, chunky pixels, a limited palette, no clouds, no moon, no trees, no ground, no text, seamless left to right.

A single pale autumn full moon, slightly yellowish grey with darker grey craters and seas, a small round pixel-art sprite in the style of a 1990s Build-engine game sky (Duke Nukem 3D), chunky pixels, a limited palette, centred, on a flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF background everywhere, no glow, no halo, no clouds, no text.

A small 1990s Czech campsite reception office seen from outside through a large single-pane window at night, a flat straight-on view filling the whole picture edge to edge: the floral curtains of the reference drawn open to the sides, a warm yellow ceiling light, a wooden counter with a brass bell and a guest book, a board of numbered keys on the wood-panelled wall, a wall calendar, a desk lamp, a potted rubber plant, the light warm in the middle and dim at the edges, dust on the glass. No people, no window frame, no text, no letters.

The cramped back room of a 1990s Czech campsite reception seen from outside through a window at night, a flat straight-on view filling the whole picture edge to edge: the floral curtains of the reference half drawn, the room dark but for the warm light of a small table lamp and the cold blue glow of an old television set on a cabinet, a sagging brown couch, a rug, dust on the glass. No people, no window frame, no text, no letters.

A single cone of warm yellow lamplight falling straight down from a street lamp at night, seen from the side, as a translucent light-shaft sprite in a 1990s Build-engine game (Duke Nukem 3D, Blood): narrow at the top where the bulb is, widening evenly to a broad base at the bottom, brightest at the top and fading toward the bottom, its brightness in three or four flat stepped bands like a palette's shade steps, a few specks of dust and tiny moths caught in it, chunky pixels, the lamp itself not shown, on a flat pure black background, no ground, no glow outside the cone, no text.

Seamless tileable texture, flat top-down orthographic view filling the whole square, in exactly the style, pixel size and palette of the reference: short meadow grass at the very end of summer, mostly muted green with patches of dry straw-yellow grass, a few clover and plantain leaves, here and there a speck of bare brown soil, no fallen leaves. Low saturation, in the style of 1990s Build-engine game textures (Duke Nukem 3D, Redneck Rampage), crisp chunky pixels, no text, no border, no watermark, must tile seamlessly on all four edges.

A sky panorama texture for a 1990s Build-engine game skybox (Duke Nukem 3D, Redneck Rampage), in the same palette and painted pixel style as the reference: the sky just before sunrise on a cool late-September morning, a pale peach and rose glow low along the horizon, rising into cold grey-blue and then a deeper slate blue high up, a few long thin streaks of grey-violet cloud lit pink from below, the last faint star or two high up, chunky pixels, a limited palette, no sun disc, no trees, no ground, no text, seamless left to right.

A single long low bank of ground mist lying over a meadow at dawn, seen from the side at eye level, soft white-grey wisps, thickest along its bottom and thinning to nothing at its top and at both ends, as a translucent smoke sprite in a 1990s Build-engine game (Blood, Duke Nukem 3D): chunky pixels, its density in three or four flat stepped shades, centred with black all round it, on a flat pure black background, no ground, no trees, no sky, no text.

Four frames side by side in one row, evenly spaced, of the same raindrop ripple on a puddle seen from straight above: frame one a tiny bright dot with a small ring, frame two a wider thin ring, frame three a wider fainter ring with a second ring inside it, frame four a wide very faint broken ring almost gone; pale grey-blue water-light rings, drawn as a sprite animation in a 1990s Build-engine game (Duke Nukem 3D, Blood): chunky pixels, hard pixel edges, a few flat shades, each frame the same size, on a flat pure black background, no puddle, no ground, no text, no numbers.

The sun as the artist of a 1990s Build-engine game (Redneck Rampage, Blood) would paint it into the sky texture of the reference, from a digitized photograph of the sun seen through hazy summer air: a small white-hot disc, a pale yellow ring round it, then a dull orange-white haze fraying out raggedly into nothing, in a few flat palette shade steps, slightly grainy, chunky pixels, centred and small in the frame, on a flat pure black background everywhere around it, no rays, no lens flare, no outline, not a cartoon, no text.

Four separate ragged clouds in a row with space between them, in exactly the look of the clouds in the reference sky texture of a 1990s Build-engine game: torn wisps of grey and dirty white cloud like a digitized photograph crudely retouched by a 1996 game artist, flat grey undersides, uneven frayed edges, low contrast, a limited muddy palette, chunky pixels, on a flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF background everywhere around them, no blue sky, no text, not cartoon, not cute, no outlines.
